Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. is a chemical technology company based in Minhang District, Shanghai, China. Located in one of Shanghai’s important industrial and innovation areas, the company is engaged in the development, sourcing, production support, and supply of chemical products for research, development, and industrial applications. Serving customers in China and abroad, Meryer focuses on providing a wide range of fine chemicals, organic intermediates, laboratory reagents, specialty chemicals, and related chemical technology services.

The company supports industries such as pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, materials science, electronics, agrochemicals, and academic research. With Shanghai’s strong transportation network, advanced laboratory resources, and well-established chemical supply chain, Meryer is positioned to respond efficiently to customer needs, including product customization, technical consultation, and small- to medium-scale chemical supply. Its location in Minhang also gives the company access to skilled professionals, research institutions, and industrial partners, which helps strengthen its service capabilities.

Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. places importance on product quality, stable supply, and customer-oriented service. The company aims to provide reliable chemical solutions that support innovation in scientific research and industrial manufacturing. By combining chemical expertise with flexible business services, Meryer has developed into a recognized participant in Shanghai’s chemical technology sector. As demand grows for high-quality specialty chemicals and research materials, the company continues to serve laboratories, manufacturers, and technology-driven enterprises with professional chemical products and support.
